bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not allowed. Bags smaller than a backpack are fine, and every bag is searched at the door.
bagPolicy.quote: We do not allow backpacks, but do not have a strict bag policy for bags smaller than backpacks.

parking.summary: The Rebel Lounge has a small lot of its own. If it's full, park in the Audio Express (2242 E Indian School Rd) or Camelback Antiques (2230 E Indian School Rd) lots and cross at the 24th St crosswalk. Cars left overnight are towed.
parking.quote: The Rebel Lounge has a modest amount of parking spaces available in our lot.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Rebel Lounge. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The bar serves drinks, and you can see the full bar menu on the FAQ page. Outside food and drinks are not allowed.
concessions.quote: No, outside food and beverages are not permitted.

accessibility.summary: Most shows are general admission and standing room only, with limited seating in the back of the room. If you need accommodations, call the venue ahead of your show to make arrangements.
accessibility.quote: Patrons with special needs should call in advance to make arrangements.

reEntry.summary: If you're under 21, there is no re-entry once you're inside. If you're 21 or older, re-entry generally isn't allowed, though staff may make an exception when it's needed.
reEntry.quote: If you are under 21 there is no re-entry once you enter the venue.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens at the doors time on your ticket and takes cash, Visa, Mastercard and American Express. You can't pick up tickets before doors. Age limits vary by show (21+, 18+, 16+ or all ages), and you need ID to drink or to enter a 21+ show.
ticketPickup.quote: The Box Office opens at the advertised "doors open" time on your ticket or on The Rebel Lounge website.

gates.summary: Doors usually open between 7pm and 8pm, and each event listing shows its own door and show times.
gates.quote: Most nights doors open somewhere between 7pm and 8pm.
